body:
## Hold

The maintainer deferred implementation of #2557 until after #2556.
Keep this issue blocked until the maintainer reviews #2557 and the two-host comparison.
No implementation starts from this proposal alone.

## Work

Use the execution method selected after the comparison.
Reuse compiled tests without a coverage change.
Build debug and heavy profiles separately with the current feature selections.
Keep the heavy-before-debug barrier across all workers.
Keep isolated binaries and UI on the cut runner for the first slice.
Stop other work on that host before an isolated step starts.
Keep doctests and clippy on the cut runner.
Keep the current snapshot policy.
Keep known-fail checks and issue-state checks on the cut runner.
Exclude those tests from ordinary heavy partitions.
Preserve the named assertion and panic checks for known failures.
Preserve checkout guards, timeouts, logs, and the total local job budget.
Check source fixtures, build outputs, runtime libraries, and working directories after transfer.

Evidence: xtask/src/plan.rs, xtask/src/queue.rs, xtask/src/lanes.rs, xtask/src/direct.rs, xtask/src/known_fail.rs, and xtask/src/checkout.rs.
Public references: https://nexte.st/docs/running/ and https://nexte.st/docs/configuration/threads-required/.

Done means: the expected debug and heavy test identities run exactly once.
The local checks remain in the verdict.
Tests verify the phase barrier, isolation, known-fail handling, and refusal of incomplete execution.
The selected execution method preserves all assertions and the snapshot policy.

Part of #2557
